package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

var ErrTeacherDialogCanonicalActionBlocked = errors.New("canonical onboarding action is not enabled in teacher dialog worker")

const CanonicalStudentTurnMaterializationSchema = "canonical-student-turn-materialization.v1"
const canonicalStudentTurnIdentitySchema = "canonical-student-turn-identity.v1"
const canonicalStudentTurnInteractionSchema = "canonical-student-turn-interaction.v1"
const canonicalStudentTurnInteractionKind = "teacher_action_receipt"

// CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization is the narrow, server-computed command
// sent to Dialog. It deliberately contains no Student mutation command and no
// LLM input/output.
type CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization struct {
	Schema                    string `json:"schema"`
	DialogID                  string `json:"dialog_id"`
	StudentID                 string `json:"student_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID         string `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	ActionReceiptID           string `json:"action_receipt_id"`
	CanonicalMessageCommandID string `json:"canonical_message_command_id"`
	CorrelationID             string `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID               string `json:"causation_id"`
	SourceMessageID           string `json:"source_message_id"`
	SourceMessageVersion      int    `json:"source_message_version"`
	BlockID                   string `json:"block_id"`
	ActionID                  string `json:"action_id"`
	SourceUIDigest            string `json:"source_ui_digest"`
	Body                      string `json:"body"`
}

type canonicalStudentTurnInteractionPayload struct {
	Schema                     string `json:"schema"`
	Kind                       string `json:"kind"`
	ActionReceiptID            string `json:"action_receipt_id"`
	SourcePromptMessageID      string `json:"source_prompt_message_id"`
	SourcePromptMessageVersion int    `json:"source_prompt_message_version"`
	BlockID                    string `json:"block_id"`
	ActionID                   string `json:"action_id"`
	SourceUIDigest             string `json:"source_ui_digest"`
}

type canonicalStudentTurnIdentityPayload struct {
	Schema                    string                                 `json:"schema"`
	DialogID                  string                                 `json:"dialog_id"`
	StudentID                 string                                 `json:"student_id"`
	PersonalTeacherID         string                                 `json:"personal_teacher_id"`
	ActionReceiptID           string                                 `json:"action_receipt_id"`
	CorrelationID             string                                 `json:"correlation_id"`
	CausationID               string                                 `json:"causation_id"`
	CanonicalMessageCommandID string                                 `json:"canonical_message_command_id"`
	Interaction               canonicalStudentTurnInteractionPayload `json:"interaction"`
}

func (input CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	normalized, err := input.Normalize()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return json.Marshal(struct {
		Identity      canonicalStudentTurnIdentityPayload `json:"identity"`
		CanonicalBody string                              `json:"canonical_body"`
	}{
		Identity: canonicalStudentTurnIdentityPayload{
			Schema: canonicalStudentTurnIdentitySchema, DialogID: normalized.DialogID, StudentID: normalized.StudentID,
			PersonalTeacherID: normalized.PersonalTeacherID, ActionReceiptID: normalized.ActionReceiptID,
			CorrelationID: normalized.CorrelationID, CausationID: normalized.CausationID,
			CanonicalMessageCommandID: normalized.CanonicalMessageCommandID,
			Interaction: canonicalStudentTurnInteractionPayload{
				Schema: canonicalStudentTurnInteractionSchema, Kind: canonicalStudentTurnInteractionKind,
				ActionReceiptID: normalized.ActionReceiptID, SourcePromptMessageID: normalized.SourceMessageID,
				SourcePromptMessageVersion: normalized.SourceMessageVersion, BlockID: normalized.BlockID,
				ActionID: normalized.ActionID, SourceUIDigest: normalized.SourceUIDigest,
			},
		},
		CanonicalBody: normalized.Body,
	})
}

func (input CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization) Normalize() (CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization, error) {
	input.Schema = strings.TrimSpace(input.Schema)
	input.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(input.DialogID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(input.PersonalTeacherID)
	input.ActionReceiptID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ActionReceiptID)
	input.CanonicalMessageCommandID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CanonicalMessageCommandID)
	input.CorrelationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CorrelationID)
	input.CausationID = strings.TrimSpace(input.CausationID)
	input.SourceMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(input.SourceMessageID)
	input.BlockID = strings.TrimSpace(input.BlockID)
	input.ActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ActionID)
	input.SourceUIDigest = strings.TrimSpace(input.SourceUIDigest)
	input.Body = strings.TrimSpace(input.Body)
	if input.Schema != CanonicalStudentTurnMaterializationSchema || !validUUID(input.DialogID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.PersonalTeacherID) ||
		!validUUID(input.ActionReceiptID) || !validUUID(input.CanonicalMessageCommandID) || input.ActionReceiptID == input.CanonicalMessageCommandID || input.ActionReceiptID != input.CorrelationID || input.ActionReceiptID != input.CausationID ||
		!ValidOnboardingFallback(input.Body) {
		return CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	evidence, err := NormalizeTeacherActionReceiptEvidence(TeacherActionReceiptEvidence{
		Schema: TeacherActionReceiptEvidenceSchema, Kind: TeacherActionReceiptEvidenceKind,
		ActionReceiptID: input.ActionReceiptID, SourcePromptMessageID: input.SourceMessageID,
		SourcePromptMessageVersion: input.SourceMessageVersion, BlockID: input.BlockID,
		ActionID: input.ActionID, SourceUIDigest: input.SourceUIDigest,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization{}, ErrInvalidTeacherOnboarding
	}
	input.SourceMessageID, input.SourceMessageVersion, input.BlockID, input.ActionID, input.SourceUIDigest = evidence.SourcePromptMessageID, evidence.SourcePromptMessageVersion, evidence.BlockID, evidence.ActionID, evidence.SourceUIDigest
	return input, nil
}

func CanonicalSourceUIDigest(raw []byte) string {
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func ResolveCanonicalOnboardingAction(source DialogAssistantUISource, binding TeacherDialogBinding, request AssistantUIActionRequest, receipt OnboardingActionReceipt) (CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization, error) {
	policyVersion, policyErr := TeacherOnboardingPromptPolicyVersion(source.AssistantUI)
	if policyErr != nil {
		return CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
	}
	for _, locale := range []string{"ru", "en"} {
		if err := ValidateOnboardingAssistantUISource(source, binding, request.MessageID, request.MessageVersion, receipt.Step, request.ActionID, locale, draftVersionFromBlockID(request.BlockID)); err != nil {
			continue
		}
		choice, ok := onboardingChoiceForPolicy(receipt.Step, request.ActionID, policyVersion)
		if !ok {
			return CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
		}
		label := choice.LabelEN
		if locale == "ru" {
			label = choice.LabelRU
		}
		body := fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s", choicePrompt(locale), label)
		return CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization{
			Schema: CanonicalStudentTurnMaterializationSchema, DialogID: binding.ID, StudentID: binding.StudentID, PersonalTeacherID: binding.PersonalTeacherID,
			ActionReceiptID: receipt.IdempotencyKey, CanonicalMessageCommandID: receipt.CanonicalMessageCommandID,
			CorrelationID: receipt.IdempotencyKey, CausationID: receipt.IdempotencyKey,
			SourceMessageID: request.MessageID, SourceMessageVersion: request.MessageVersion,
			BlockID: request.BlockID, ActionID: request.ActionID, SourceUIDigest: CanonicalSourceUIDigest(source.AssistantUI), Body: body,
		}.Normalize()
	}
	return CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization{}, ErrTeacherOnboardingConflict
}

func choicePrompt(locale string) string {
	if locale == "ru" {
		return "Выбираю"
	}
	return "I choose"
}

func draftVersionFromBlockID(blockID string) int64 {
	_, _, version, ok := onboardingBlockIdentity(blockID)
	if !ok {
		return -1
	}
	return version
}

func NewDialogCanonicalStudentTurn(binding TeacherDialogBinding, message DialogMessage, expected CanonicalStudentTurnMaterialization) (DialogMessage, error) {
	normalizedBinding, err := NewTeacherDialogBinding(binding)
	if err != nil {
		return DialogMessage{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	normalized, err := expected.Normalize()
	if err != nil || normalized.DialogID != normalizedBinding.ID || normalized.StudentID != normalizedBinding.StudentID || normalized.PersonalTeacherID != normalizedBinding.PersonalTeacherID {
		return DialogMessage{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	message.ID = strings.TrimSpace(message.ID)
	message.DialogID = strings.TrimSpace(message.DialogID)
	message.SenderID = strings.TrimSpace(message.SenderID)
	message.PersonalTeacherID = strings.TrimSpace(message.PersonalTeacherID)
	message.ReplyToMessageID = strings.TrimSpace(message.ReplyToMessageID)
	message.Channel = normalizeDialogMessageChannel(message.Channel)
	message.CreatedAt = message.CreatedAt.UTC()
	if !validUUID(message.ID) || message.DialogID != normalized.DialogID || message.AuthorType != DialogMessageAuthorUser || message.Channel != DialogMessageChannelWeb || message.SenderID != normalized.StudentID || message.PersonalTeacherID != "" || message.ReplyToMessageID != normalized.SourceMessageID || message.Body != normalized.Body || message.Status != 1 || message.MessageSequence < 1 || message.LastEventSequence < message.MessageSequence || message.CreatedAt.IsZero() {
		return DialogMessage{}, ErrInvalidDialogContext
	}
	return message, nil
}
